title: 미워할 수 있다면
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop ballad featuring a baritone male vocal. The arrangement centers on a grand piano playing sustained chords and melodic fills. A string ensemble provides legato pads and counter-melodies. Acoustic guitar enters with light strumming. The percussion is minimal, consisting of a soft kick drum and subtle shaker. The track is in the key of C Major with a tempo of 72 BPM in 4/4 time. The vocal performance utilizes a mix of chest voice and breathy falsetto with moderate plate reverb.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[grand piano, soft string pads]

[Verse 1]
[baritone male vocals]
네가 좋아하던 노래가 [acoustic guitar enters]
카페 안에서 흘러
얼음 녹는 소리에 섞여 들려
찬 바람이 불면
코끝이 먼저 기억해
우리가 걸었던 그 길 혼자 걸어
낙엽이 밟히는 소리
미워할 수 있다면 [vocal shifts to falsetto]
이렇게까지
